verdict.rationale: Rippling documents several AI-driven insight features: AI-built reports/dashboards on labor cost trends (rippling-docs-5), a natural-language headcount dashboard prompt ('Show me headcount vs plan', rippling-docs-42), and AI-driven benefits guidance/document review (rippling-docs-20, rippling-docs-21). These support the story of getting AI-generated insights from data inside the product, but the evidence is all first-party marketing copy scattered across a few modules rather than a unified, deeply documented AI-insights capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features actually working, broader coverage across all modules (e.g., IT, spend), and technical detail on how insights are generated.
